features.feature_value: Uses slangy interjection "lmao" with humorous framing
features.rationale: The post includes the explicit internet/slang marker "lmao" to set an informal, dismissive tone.

features.feature_value: Multiple hashtags naming a state candidate and the opposed politician with praise
features.rationale: The text uses hashtag formatting to directly tag political actors and then asserts approval.

features.feature_value: Argument grounded in timeline reconstruction and claimed reasoning about political motives
features.evidence_span: "look at the timeline" - it’s not hard to put together what the original reason for Trump running even was
features.rationale: The structure invites the reader to infer intent from a stated chronological sequence.

features.feature_value: Suggests a protected political “machine” and concealed wrongdoing
features.evidence_span: "the whole damn machine protects its own"
features.rationale: The “machine protects its own” phrasing implies coordinated concealment rather than ordinary disagreement.

features.feature_value: Defines an outgroup threat (“fascists”/“socialist collapse”) and vows resistance
features.evidence_span: "fall into the hands of fascists" / "socialist collapse"
features.rationale: The text draws a stark in-group/out-group boundary with an existential threat framing.

features.feature_value: Uses an upfront example to justify calling someone “stupid/clueless” vs “disingenuous/deliberately dishonest”
features.evidence_span: "I call her either stupid or in disingenuous" / "why I call him either completely clueless or deliberately dishonest"
features.rationale: It embeds justification via a labeled assessment and then pivots to a concrete example.

features.feature_value: Direct urgency directive to act on climate with a cited science source
features.evidence_span: "We need to take urgent #ClimateAction right now"
features.rationale: The post explicitly instructs immediate action in the climate policy domain.

features.feature_value: Frames aid-cutting as punishing dissent; uses strong ridicule (“toddler throwing a tantrum”)
features.evidence_span: "That's not strength, that's a toddler throwing a tantrum."
features.rationale: It uses a mocking analogy while condemning the proposed punishment for disagreement.
